note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: Meta settlement could clear the way for new AI product launches, Morgan Stanley says
items.blurb: Analysts say Meta's $18 billion settlement removes a legal overhang that had delayed several consumer AI product launches.

items.title: G20 live updates: White House readying tariffs on semiconductors, Lutnick tells CNBC
items.blurb: Nvidia's Huang, Musk and Treasury's Bessent debate AI benefits and data-center backlash as semiconductor tariffs are prepared.

items.title: Anthropic changes data retention policy after pushback from customers
items.blurb: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 alongside Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, giving business customers control over data review and storage.

items.title: AI token prices are hitting new record lows
items.blurb: Inference costs keep falling as cheap Chinese open-weight models such as Moonshot's Kimi K3 undercut US frontier lab pricing.

items.title: Apple, OpenAI lawsuit timeline: How the legal fight keeps escalating
items.blurb: OpenAI's latest filing argues Apple failed to protect itself; a judge hears the escalating device-and-model dispute Oct 1.

items.title: Students are reconsidering their majors, career paths and industries due to AI: CNBC survey
items.blurb: Thirty-one percent of enrolled students and workers have changed or considered changing target industry because of AI, a CNBC/SurveyMonkey survey finds.

items.title: OpenAI says Astra AI model is its first that crosses 'Critical' cybersecurity capability
items.blurb: First model OpenAI rates Critical for cyber; advanced offensive features limited to vetted alpha testers at launch.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks beats quarterly estimates on AI demand, continues acquisition spree
items.blurb: Revenue up 34% to $3.41B as agentic cyberattack risk drives enterprise security spending.

items.title: Anthropic inks $35B deal with Nvidia-backed cloud provider Lambda: Report
items.blurb: A reported $35 billion compute contract signals Anthropic locking in capacity outside its existing hyperscaler partners.

items.title: Palo Alto CEO says $1 trillion of cybersecurity infrastructure isn't ready for AI
items.blurb: Nikesh Arora argues pre-AI security stacks cannot respond at machine speed to agentic attacks, forcing a broad replacement cycle.

items.title: The Information bets bigger on video with new AI show
items.blurb: A weekly AI interview show launching Sept. 14 signals trade press expanding coverage of technical AI problems.

items.title: Bank of England chief warns new AI models threaten global financial stability
items.blurb: Governor Andrew Bailey says frontier models could raise financial-system cyber risk and trigger a disorderly market correction.

items.title: Exclusive: AI advocacy group launches data center push in battleground states
items.blurb: Industry-funded group with roughly $50M opens campaigns in Kansas, Ohio and Wisconsin to blunt data-center opposition.

items.title: OpenAI's ad business shows blistering growth, hits $1 billion annualized revenue run rate
items.blurb: Advertising becomes a material second revenue line as OpenAI faces pressure to justify its $852 billion valuation.

items.title: Why Nvidia and CrowdStrike are up in an otherwise down stock market

items.title: House Intelligence Committee warns of 'Black Swan' AI risks
items.blurb: Committee urges U.S. spy agencies to prepare for AI-enabled weapons development and attack planning by adversaries.

items.blurb: White House and industry mount a counter-campaign as local opposition to AI data centers spreads.

items.title: Here are the 3 big things we're watching in the stock market in the week ahead
items.blurb: AI positioning dominates the week's setup, with Broadcom's AI semiconductor revenue and a jobs report both due.

items.title: Tech backlash reaches fever pitch as AI angst collides with social media fears
items.blurb: Public sentiment against AI firms hardens as job-loss fears and local data-center siting fights converge ahead of elections.
